title: Blockception - Full
description: Every block, item, and mob in Minecraft, rebuilt out of tiny Minecraft blocks. The complete photomosaic pack — everything is made of everything.
body: # 🌍 Blockception Full **The whole game, made of blocks.** Blockception Full is the complete edition of the Blockception series: every **block**, **item**, and **mob** texture rebuilt as a tiny **photomosaic** of Minecraft blocks. Each pixel is replaced by the real block whose average colour matches it best, so the entire world keeps its familiar look — while hiding hundreds of miniature blocks inside every single texture. ## ✨ What it does - **Blocks, items, and mobs** all rebuilt from a palette of ~450 real Minecraft block tiles. - Each source pixel becomes a full **16×16 block tile**, so every 16×16 texture becomes a crisp 256×256 mosaic. - Colour-matched per pixel, so your world stays recognisable — it just gains a hidden layer of detail everywhere you look. - Transparent areas stay transparent; animated textures keep animating. ## 🎯 Scope This is the **all-in-one** pack — it combines the three scoped packs into one download: - **[Blockception Blocks](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blockception-blocks)** — blocks only - **[Blockception Items](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blockception-items)** — items only - **[Blockception Entities](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blockception-entities)** — mobs only --- ### 🌍 Want Your Own Minecraft Server?
